written.headline: Microsoft researchers prove 31-year-old KLS conjecture in high-dimensional geometry
written.summary: Researchers at Microsoft Research have proved the Kannan‑Lovász‑Simonovits (KLS) conjecture, a problem first posed in 1995. The proof used a human‑directed AI process and has been independently verified and formally checked.

written.headline: Microsoft equips over 330,000 Volkswagen Group employees with Copilot
written.summary: Microsoft announced that Volkswagen Group has rolled out Microsoft Copilot to more than 330,000 staff, aiming to boost productivity and decision‑making across the company. The deployment includes Copilot Chat, Work IQ and over 26,000 active agents.

written.headline: AI tools uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting up to 70% of websites
written.summary: Two critical memory‑safety bugs (CVE‑2026‑109618 and CVE‑2026‑109619) were discovered in PHP, a language that powers roughly 70% of web sites. The flaws were identified using AI models from OpenAI and Google’s Wiz, and patches were released on October 21.

written.headline: Anthropic argues fair use for song lyrics in Claude training as US judge hears case
written.summary: Anthropic asked US District Judge Eumi Lee to deem its use of copyrighted song lyrics to train its Claude chatbot as fair use. Publishers UMG, Concord and ABKCO argue the training harms songwriters, citing nearly 120,000 requests for synthetic lyrics.
